source.name: Footy Headlines: 2026 Chinese Super League Kits - All Releases So Far
source.quote: Nike has officially unveiled the 2026 Home Kits for all 16 teams competing in the Chinese Super League (CSL).
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The article has its own 'Yunnan Yukun' section showing the 2026 home kit. The club's launch was reported on 2026-01-28 by Sohu (都市时报, https://www.sohu.com/a/981123066_120815119), crediting the club (来源：云南玉昆足球俱乐部): '2026赛季云南玉昆NIKE主场球衣正式发布！' — its images show the retail shirt carrying no sponsor branding.

summary: 2026 home kit (Nike, launched 28 January 2026). No commercial front sponsor: the club published a 2026-season partnership brochure in December 2025 valuing the naming-rights package, which included front-of-shirt advertising, at 30 million yuan, but Tencent News' survey of all 16 CSL clubs' 2026 chest advertisements (17 March 2026, https://view.inews.qq.com/a/20260317A0862Q00) states the shirt front still shows only the club's own name 「云南玉昆」. No 2026 sleeve, back or shorts sponsor is named in any source that could be opened (footballkitarchive.com returns 403 to scripts; kitstown has no 2026 page for the club), so the list is not marked complete.
